title: Migrate & Protect Applications with Entra
author_notes: Product-named (merges the app-migration onboarding+architecture engagement items). Distinct from the existing 'SAML App Integration Factory' (SSO-at-scale) — this is AD FS migration + on-prem publishing; cross-reference. PowerShell (Microsoft.Graph / Az) + KQL. Cross-references existing Entra solutions (ENTPIM/ENTPASSKEY/ENTZTCA/ENTIGA, Conditional Access Integration, Hybrid Identity, SAML App Factory, enterprise-app governance) rather than duplicating them (gap-only). Change scripts -WhatIf/report-only-first + break-glass; licensing (P1/P2/Governance/GSA/Verified ID) + preview flagged verify.
